tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches low to peer into a narrow cave opening, one hand braced on the rock wall, head tilted as it scans the dark interior.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter angle from behind, cave mouth framing the subject
tasks.visibility_requirement: One supporting hand visible against the rock; the other arm hidden by the body.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎蹲低探看狭窄洞口，一手撑岩壁。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a fallen log spanning a stream, arms out for stability, one foot lifted mid-step, gazing down at the water swirling beneath.
tasks.camera: side view at water level, log diagonal across frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both outstretched hands visible; feet on the log, soles not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在横倒树干上保持平衡。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a campfire blowing gently on the embers, cheeks puffed, one hand cupped near the flames, the other steadying a small cooking pot.
tasks.camera: medium close-up from front-left, firelight warm on the face
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible near the fire; lower body out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎跪在篝火旁吹旺余烬。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger stretches upward on tiptoe to pluck a high hanging fruit, tail curled for balance, face turned up with concentration, the branch bending under the reach.
tasks.camera: low angle looking up, fruit branch overhead
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both raised hands visible; feet on tiptoe, soles not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎踮脚伸手摘高处果实。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches over a patch of soft sand, one finger tracing a spiral pattern while the other hand rests flat on the ground for support, head lowered in focus.
tasks.camera: high angle looking down, pattern and hands in view
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible on the sand; feet outside frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在沙地上画螺旋图案。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out over a wooden railing to feed a bird perched on a post below, one hand extended with crumbs, body angled forward, gaze following the bird.
tasks.camera: medium shot from the side, railing and post in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one over the railing and one on it.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎靠在木栏杆上喂鸟。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger wedges a shoulder against a heavy wooden crate, pushing it across a plank floor, both hands flat on the side, legs braced in a wide stance with effort.
tasks.camera: low wide shot from front-right, crate and floor visible
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible pressing the crate; feet not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎用肩膀和双手推木箱。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger hides behind a large potted fern, peeking out with one eye visible between leaves, one hand parting the fronds, body mostly concealed in the dim room.
tasks.camera: eye-level medium shot through the leaves
tasks.visibility_requirement: One parting hand visible; the other arm occluded by foliage.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎躲在蕨类植物后探头偷看。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger threads a needle by a window, holding the needle close to one eye and the thread pinched in the other hand, mouth slightly open in concentration.
tasks.camera: extreme close-up of face and hands, window light from behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible at chest height; lower body out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎对着窗光穿针引线。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a stack of crates with legs dangling over the edge, leaning back on one hand and holding a lantern up with the other, lighting the rafters above.
tasks.camera: low angle from below, crates and rafters framing the shot
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one bracing on the crate top.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐在木箱堆上举着灯笼照亮房梁。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger clambers over a low garden wall, belly and knees on the stone cap, one hand swinging over while the other grips the edge, tail flicking up.
tasks.camera: side view slightly behind, wall cutting the frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the wall edge; legs partly hidden by the wall.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎翻越低矮花园石墙。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger scrubs a stubborn stain from a large pot, both hands gripping a brush, shoulders hunched, water splashing onto the floor around the base of the pot.
tasks.camera: medium shot from front-high angle, pot and brush in focus
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the brush; feet outside frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎用力刷洗大锅上的污渍。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger winds a long rope around one forearm and elbow, pulling it taut with the other hand, leaning back with weight on the heels, face turned to the side.
tasks.camera: side-angle medium shot, rope looping through the frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clear of the rope confusion and visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎把长绳缠在小臂上拉紧。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger drops through a trapdoor in the floor, only head, shoulders and one gripping hand visible at the opening, eyes wide with surprise as the room recedes.
tasks.camera: high angle looking down into the room from above
tasks.visibility_requirement: One hand gripping the trapdoor edge visible; other arm below the floor.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎从地板暗门跌落，仅露头肩和一只手。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crawls through a low tunnel of roots and earth, face forward near the camera, one hand reaching ahead into the darker passage.
tasks.camera: front-on low view inside the tunnel, shallow depth
tasks.visibility_requirement: One advancing hand visible ahead; the trailing arm hidden by the body.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在树根土洞中匍匐前进。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans over a bridge rail to watch its reflection in still water, one hand trailing just above the surface, the other holding the rail, ears perked.
tasks.camera: high angle over the rail, face and reflection framed together
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one on the rail and one above water.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎靠桥栏看水中倒影。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger pries open a wooden chest with both hands, leaning its weight into the lid, face lit from the glow spilling out, shoulders squared with effort.
tasks.camera: front-low angle, chest and glowing light dominating
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible gripping the lid edge.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎双手撬开发光木箱。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger trips over a coiled garden hose and pitches forward, arms flailing, one knee bent to catch itself, mouth open in a startled shout.
tasks.camera: wide side shot, hose and path in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flailing hands visible; feet not shown.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎被水管绊倒向前扑。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger squeezes through a partially open window, shoulders twisted, one hand on the frame and the other reaching toward the room inside, tail caught behind.
tasks.camera: from inside the room, window framing the body
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the frame and sill; lower body outside.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎扭身从半开窗户挤进房间。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger hangs upside down from a sturdy branch by both hands, knees hooked over the limb, examining a bird's nest below with an upside-down curious expression.
tasks.camera: inverted low angle looking up past the branch
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both gripping hands visible on the branch; legs behind the limb.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎倒挂在树枝上看鸟巢。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches behind a curtain, only the head and one hand poking out as it watches someone cross the room, eyes narrowed and alert.
tasks.camera: medium shot from the room, curtain edge in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: One peeking hand visible outside the curtain; other arm hidden.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎躲在帘后偷看房间动静。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger swings a long-handled axe down upon a piece of firewood on a chopping block, torso twisted, both hands gripping the haft, chips flying from the block.
tasks.camera: low angle from the side, axe arc and block visible
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible on the axe handle.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎挥斧劈柴，木屑飞溅。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back beneath a low wooden cart, arms extended up, working on an axle with a small wrench in one hand and a bolt in the other.
tasks.camera: low side view under the cart, wheels framing the scene
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible against the underside of the cart.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎躺在车底修理车轴。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reaches into a deep barrel of grain, one arm sunk to the elbow, face turned away with a grimace, the other hand steadying the barrel rim.
tasks.camera: medium front angle, barrel dominating the lower frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one at the barrel rim and one entering it.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎伸手探入谷桶深处。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger steps carefully along a narrow stone ledge on a steep wall, back pressed to the rock, one hand flat against the wall and the other pointing ahead for balance.
tasks.camera: wide side view showing the drop beyond the ledge
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible against the wall and ahead; feet on the ledge.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎背贴岩壁在窄石沿侧移。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger ducks under a low doorway carrying a stack of books, chin pressing the top book down, both hands wrapped around the wobbling tower.
tasks.camera: front-three-quarter medium shot, doorway framing
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible supporting the stack; feet out of frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎低头抱着一摞书过矮门。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger slumps back against a boulder after a long climb, chest heaving, one forearm across a raised knee, the other hand resting on the ground beside it, eyes half-closed.
tasks.camera: low side angle, boulder and distant ridge behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible, one on the knee arm and one on the ground.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎登山后在巨石旁瘫坐喘息。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger peers into a telescope aimed out a round attic window, one hand adjusting the focus knob, the other bracing the tube, one eye squinting into the eyepiece.
tasks.camera: profile medium shot, telescope pointing to window
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the telescope body and knob.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在阁楼用望远镜观测窗外。

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger drags a heavy sack across a wooden dock toward a waiting boat, leaning back into the pull, both hands gripping the sack's tied neck, rope trailing behind.
tasks.camera: wide low shot along the dock planks
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible on the sack neck; feet on the planks.
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎在码头上拖着沉重麻袋走向小船。
